significance: The great Shiva temple of Vedaranyam, the ancient Tirumaraikkadu ('forest of the Vedas'), and the only shrine mentioned in all seven Thirumurais of the Tamil Saiva canon. Chola kings from Rajaraja I onward endowed it richly.
story: Its doors, sealed since the Vedas themselves worshipped here, are said to have been sung open by Appar and closed again by Sambandar's hymn.
